bridge.from_prev: The overseer flags Rhea's party for 'audit compliance' encounters.
bridge.to_next: Pushed to the brink, Rhea prepares a counter-audit to crash the local node.

chapters.goal: Survive the overseer's targeted harassment, which uses debt logic and rigged encounters to try and bankrupt Rhea's HP and resources.

sections.end_condition: The party barely escapes the first wave of rigged encounters, their resources heavily drained.
sections.intent: The overseer weaponizes the environment, spawning debt-collecting mobs and applying severe administrative debuffs.

scenes.outcome: The party survives the initial ambush but loses several valuable consumables to the debt tethers.
scenes.summary: Still reeling from the overseer's red-tier warning, Rhea and Vance are immediately ambushed by 'Debt Collectors'—system-spawned mobs that drain HP and inventory items instead of dealing standard damage. Rhea has to use her newly acquired stats to physically block the extraction tethers.
scenes.transition_in_text: The burning crimson warning icon pulses in Rhea's vision just as the ash-covered ground erupts, disgorging three wire-frame hounds.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vance crushes the last hound's skull with his iron bludgeon, but not before a glowing tether yanks three health potions from Rhea's belt.

scenes.end_condition_echo: The party barely escapes the first wave of rigged encounters, their resources heavily drained.
scenes.outcome: The party barely escapes the first wave of rigged encounters, their resources heavily drained.
scenes.summary: Fleeing into the Ash Wastes to break line of sight, the party is hit by a localized 'Audit Tax' debuff that halves their movement speed and drains stamina. They are forced to barricade themselves inside a ruined tollbooth to wait out the debuff timer while fending off a second wave of collectors.
scenes.transition_in_text: Dragging her suddenly leaden boots through the gray dunes, Rhea shoves Vance toward the crumbling stone archway of a ruined tollbooth.
scenes.transition_out_text: Rhea slams the rotting wooden door shut, sliding a rusted iron bar into place as the debt hounds begin scratching at the exterior stone.

sections.title: Weaponized Bureaucracy

sections.end_condition: Rhea identifies the specific administrative hub powering the overseer's targeted harassment.
sections.intent: Rhea realizes they cannot out-fight the system's infinite resources and must attack the overseer's mana/debt ledger directly.

scenes.outcome: Rhea discovers that the debt mobs are being funded by a localized administrative hub, meaning the overseer has a finite budget for his harassment.
scenes.summary: Inside the tollbooth, Rhea analyzes the combat log and realizes the debt hounds aren't normal mobs; they are physical manifestations of the overseer's mana ledger. She forces Unit 734 to interface with the tollbooth's dead terminal to trace the hounds' spawn origin.
scenes.transition_in_text: Ignoring the frantic scratching at the door, Rhea rips the casing off the tollbooth's dead terminal and jams Unit 734's interface cable into the exposed copper wiring.
scenes.transition_out_text: The terminal screen flickers to life, displaying a cascading ledger of mana expenditures flowing from a single, heavily fortified coordinate.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea identifies the specific administrative hub powering the overseer's targeted harassment.
scenes.outcome: Rhea identifies the specific administrative hub powering the overseer's targeted harassment.
scenes.summary: Vance holds the door against the escalating mob pressure while Rhea decrypts the coordinate data. She pinpoints the exact location of the local administrative hub and realizes that if they can inject a corrupted ledger entry there, the overseer's debt system will crash.
scenes.transition_in_text: Vance braces his shoulder against the splintering wood as Rhea frantically types decryption commands into the glowing green terminal.
scenes.transition_out_text: She extracts the glowing coordinate chip from the console, grinning as the location of the administrative hub burns into her map interface.

sections.title: Targeting the Ledger

sections.end_condition: The party stands at the threshold of the administrative sanctum, fully equipped for the breach.
sections.intent: The party prepares a counter-audit, gathering the specific items and exploits needed to crash the local node.

scenes.outcome: Rhea successfully crafts the Null-Value Token, consuming the last of their high-tier crafting materials.
scenes.summary: The party breaks out of the tollbooth and navigates a treacherous path through the Ash Wastes to reach the hub. Along the way, Rhea uses the remaining refunded loot to craft a 'Null-Value Token'—a physical exploit designed to trigger a divide-by-zero error in the overseer's ledger.
scenes.transition_in_text: Kicking the ruined door outward, Vance clears a path through the stunned hounds, allowing Rhea to sprint toward the jagged obsidian spires of the Hub Perimeter.
scenes.transition_out_text: Crouched behind a basalt boulder, Rhea fuses a silver coin with a corrupted data shard, producing a heavy, light-swallowing token.

scenes.end_condition_echo: The party stands at the threshold of the administrative sanctum, fully equipped for the breach.
scenes.outcome: The party stands at the threshold of the administrative sanctum, fully equipped for the breach.
scenes.summary: The party arrives at the heavily guarded entrance of the administrative sanctum. Vance equips his upgraded gear to draw the aggro of the elite bureaucratic guards, while Rhea readies the Null-Value Token for the breach.
scenes.transition_in_text: Creeping past the basalt boulders, the party reaches the polished marble steps of the Sanctum Threshold, where two towering, gold-plated sentinels stand guard.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vance tightens his grip on his iron bludgeon, nodding to Rhea as she slips the Null-Value Token into her palm, ready to kick the doors in.

sections.title: Preparing the Counter-Audit

chapters.stakes_shift: From flying under the radar to fighting a defensive war against the system's bureaucracy.
chapters.title: Administrative Cruelty
